You'll find lots to explore on the homepage.Error code: M7701-1003PHOTO BY MIKE MARQUES/WWE VIA GETTY IMAGESWWE WrestleMania 42 Full Results: Recap, Winners, and Biggest Moments Here are the new champions, winners, and losers of WrestleMania 42.WrestleMania 42 delivered a monumental weekend, bringing captivating rivalries and long-standing feuds to a head in high-stakes clashes and championship showdowns on a stacked card. There were countless epic moments yesterday, from IShowSpeed landing a splash on Logan Paul, to the shocking return of Paige, to Oba Femi knocking off Brock Lesnar.Scroll on for a full recap of everything that went down and the winners and losers from Night 1 and Night 2.WrestleMania 42 Night 1 results (Saturday, April 18):LA Knight, Jey Uso, and Jimmy Uso defeated Logan Paul, Austin Theory, and IShowSpeed (The Vision)Jacob Fatu defeated Drew McIntyreBrie Bella and Paige defeated Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flar, Bayley and Lyra Valkyria, and Nia Jax and Lash Legend in a Fatal 4-Way for the WWE Women's Tag Team ChampionshipBecky Lynch defeated AJ Lee for the Women’s Intercontinental ChampionshipGunther defeated Seth RollinsLiv Morgan defeated Stephanie Vaquer for the Women’s World ChampionshipCody Rhodes defeated Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE ChampionshipWrestleMania 42 Night 2 results (Sunday, April 19):Oba Femi defeated Brock Lesnar Penta defeated Je’Von Evans, Dragon Lee, Rusev, JD McDonagh and Rey Mysterio in a Ladder Match for the Intercontinental Championship Trick Williams defeated Sami Zayn for the United States ChampionshipFinn Bálor defeated Dominik MysterioRhea Ripley defeated Jade Cargill for the WWE Women’s ChampionshipRoman Reigns defeated CM Punk for the World Heavyweight ChampionshipDid Brock Lesnar win at WrestleMania 42?No, Oba Femi defeated Brock Lesnar and after the match, The Beast removed his gloves and boots, which often indicates a Superstar retiring.Did Paige return to WWE?Yes, Nikki Bella was unable to compete because of injury and Paige served as her replacement, teaming with Brie Bella. Watch Paige’s return below.Did Bron Breakker return?Bron Breakker returned and attacked Seth Rollins, causing him to lose to Gunther.Did Bianca Belair return?Bianca Belair returned to announce her pregnancy to the WWE Universe.Was John Cena at WrestleMania 42?John Cena hosted WrestleMania 42 Night 1 and Night 2, pumping up the Las Vegas crowd.Sorry, this content requires third-party cookie consent to view.View your cookie preferences here.When was WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 Night 1 was Saturday, April 18 at 3 p.m. PT/ 6 p.m. ETWrestleMania 42 Night 2 was Sunday, April 19 at 3 p.m. PT/ 6 p.m. ETWhere was WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 took place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.Who sang National Anthem at WrestleMania 42?Grammy-nominated recording artist Joe Jonas performed the National Anthem on Night 2 of WrestleMania.How to watch WrestleMania 42:WrestleMania 42 streamed on ESPN in the United States. However, members in the following countries and regions will be able to tune in live on Netflix:Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Ecuador, Egypt, Finland, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Indonesia, Israel, Kuwait, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, and United Kingdom.For the first time in WrestleMania history, the opening hour of each night will air live on cable TV, Saturday on ESPN2 and Sunday on ESPN, before fully shifting to streaming.Make sure to catch an action-packed episode of Raw after WrestleMania, streaming on Netflix April 20 at 5 p.m. PT / 8 p.m. ET. Click here for more details on the upcoming episode of Raw.Can I watch previous WrestleMania events on Netflix?Yes, every WrestleMania in WWE history is streaming on Netflix. Click here to open the complete WrestleMania Vault. Every WrestleMania main event in history:Since 1985, the main event of WrestleMania has featured WWE’s biggest superstars competing in the most anticipated matches of the year. These headline bouts often determine championships, settle long-running rivalries, and create iconic moments cherished and revisited by fans in years to come.
